project.title: Integrated Daily Routine for Paediatric Ward and Childcare Unit
project.objective: Design and pilot a unified daily care routine that improves safety, hygiene, and wellbeing for children across the paediatric ward and on-site childcare unit.
deliverables: Documented standard daily routine for paediatric ward and childcare unit
Hygiene and sanitation checklist for shared spaces and equipment
Meal and snack distribution schedule aligned with care activities
Activity plan to support children's emotional and social wellbeing
Orientation guide for new staff on the integrated routine
constraints: Routine must comply with existing healthcare and childcare regulations
No increase in total staffing hours during the pilot
Minimal disruption to current medication and treatment schedules
All procedures must be understandable for new staff within one shift
Pilot must run during normal weekday operations only

risks.risk: New routine conflicts with existing medical procedures or medication times.
risks.mitigation: Review draft routine with nursing staff and head nurse before pilot; adjust time slots to avoid clashes.

risks.risk: Staff do not consistently follow the new hygiene and sanitation steps.
risks.mitigation: Create simple visual checklists, do short briefings at shift start, and monitor adherence during first week.

risks.risk: Children become unsettled by changes to their usual activities and meal times.
risks.mitigation: Introduce changes gradually, explain routines in child-friendly ways, and keep key comfort activities unchanged.

risks.risk: Communication gaps between healthcare assistants and childcare workers cause missed tasks.
risks.mitigation: Add handover notes template and fixed check-in times between teams; clarify responsibilities in writing.

themes.why_relevant: Staff handle cleaning, sanitation, and sterilisation; routine must reduce infection risk in shared child spaces.
Many children are stressed or traumatised; activities and routines must support emotional stability and trust.
Assistants distribute meals and snacks; timing and diet must align with care, treatment, and activity plans.
Multiple assistants share tasks; clear handovers avoid missed care, cleaning, or observation duties.
All routines must follow health and childcare legislation and internal quality standards.

backlog.task: Map current daily routines in paediatric ward and childcare unit, including key tasks and timings.
definition_of_done: List of current tasks by time of day is documented for both areas
Pain points and overlaps are highlighted
Document is shared in channel and acknowledged by team

backlog.task: Draft integrated daily routine that aligns care, hygiene, and activity blocks for children.
definition_of_done: Draft schedule covers morning, midday, afternoon, and evening blocks
Includes cleaning, meals, rest, and activity times
Reviewed once with at least one childcare worker and one nurse

backlog.task: Create hygiene and sanitation checklist for shared child spaces and equipment.
definition_of_done: Checklist covers rooms, toys, surfaces, and meal areas
Frequencies and responsible roles are specified
Infection control specialist feedback is incorporated

backlog.task: Design a weekly activity plan that supports children's social and emotional wellbeing.
definition_of_done: Plan includes at least two structured activities per day
Activities are suitable for mixed ages and abilities
Plan is aligned with treatment and rest times in the routine

backlog.task: Align meal and snack distribution schedule with the new routine and dietary guidance.
definition_of_done: Meal and snack times are listed for each age group
Schedule avoids conflict with procedures and activities
Dietary services supervisor confirms feasibility

backlog.task: Draft a simple orientation guide for new staff on the integrated routine.
definition_of_done: Guide explains key time blocks, responsibilities, and checklists
Includes quick tips for working with stressed or traumatised children
Reviewed by childcare coordinator and ward manager

backlog.task: Create a handover notes template to improve communication between shifts.
definition_of_done: Template includes sections for hygiene, meals, mood, and incidents
Tested in at least two consecutive shifts
Team agrees template is clear and practical

backlog.task: Pilot the integrated routine for one week and log observations and incidents.
definition_of_done: Routine is followed for five consecutive weekdays
Deviations and incidents are recorded using agreed format
Short debrief notes are shared after the pilot week

backlog.task: Collect informal feedback from children and families about the new routine.
definition_of_done: At least five children and three families are asked for feedback
Key comments are summarised without personal identifiers
Summary is posted in the channel for review

backlog.task: Adjust routine, checklists, and activity plan based on pilot results.
definition_of_done: Main issues from pilot and feedback are listed
Updated versions of routine, checklist, and activity plan are produced
Stakeholders confirm readiness for wider rollout

artifacts.title: Current Daily Routines Mapping
artifacts.used_for: Reference of existing tasks and timings in ward and childcare unit to inform the new integrated routine.

artifacts.title: Hygiene and Sanitation Checklist for Child Spaces
artifacts.used_for: Guides assistants on what to clean, how often, and how to record completion during shifts.

artifacts.title: Integrated Daily Routine and Meal Schedule
artifacts.used_for: Shared timetable for care, cleaning, meals, rest, and activities across both areas.

artifacts.title: Child Wellbeing Activity Plan
artifacts.used_for: Provides structured daily and weekly activities to support social and emotional development.

artifacts.title: New Staff Orientation Guide for Integrated Routine
artifacts.used_for: Helps new staff quickly understand key steps, responsibilities, and communication rules.

artifacts.title: Shift Handover Notes Template
artifacts.used_for: Ensures consistent information transfer on hygiene, meals, mood, and incidents between shifts.

artifacts.title: Pilot Week Observation and Incident Log
artifacts.used_for: Records deviations, issues, and notable events during the pilot of the new routine.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current routines and main pain points before designing the new schedule.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking everyone to share how their current day runs and what does not work.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the list of core daily tasks that must appear in the integrated routine.
Confirm which pain points are top priority to fix in the first version.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review and finalise the draft integrated routine and hygiene checklist.
threads_plan.trigger: Post first draft of the integrated routine and ask for comments and corrections.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the time blocks for care, cleaning, meals, and activities in the integrated routine.
Agree on the final version of the hygiene and sanitation checklist for the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on the activity plan and how to support children emotionally during the new routine.
threads_plan.trigger: Share the draft activity plan and ask for input on suitability for different ages and conditions.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select which daily activities are mandatory and which are optional during the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Prepare for the pilot week, including handover process and logging of incidents.
threads_plan.trigger: Announcement that the pilot will start next week and request for final checks on handover and logging.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on how and when to use the handover notes template each shift.
Confirm what counts as an incident that must be logged during the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot results and decide on adjustments before wider rollout.
threads_plan.trigger: Post summary of pilot observations and feedback and ask for improvement suggestions.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide which changes from the pilot will be kept, modified, or dropped for the final routine.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in at shift start to flag any routine or hygiene issues for that day.
End-of-day brief summary post capturing key incidents and mood trends among children.
Midweek quick poll on what in the routine is hardest to follow and why.
Post-pilot retrospective thread to capture lessons learned and ideas for next iteration.
